content.comment_body: I'm unable to connect my [product_name] to the [product_name] software, can anyone help identify the issue? Device: [article_no] Software: [product_name] [version_no] Both the device and PC are linked to a wireless router. I've tried multiple IP addresses. See attached [document] for more details. Also attempted a direct LAN connection using a static IP within the device's range, but had no success.

You currently have [product_name] [version_no]. To work with this, you need the matching [product_name] [version_no]. You can download the upgrade here: [url] However, please note that this download has export restrictions. You will be required to log in and register to access export-restricted software, and certain data will be needed for this process.

analysis.insight_summary: A user experienced trouble connecting a [product_name] device to its configuration software over both wireless and LAN setups. The root issue is compatibility—the installed software version doesn't support the user's hardware version, resulting in failed connection attempts. The lack of clear communication about version compatibility within the software and documentation contributes to user confusion and ineffective troubleshooting.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate a smooth connection between their [product_name] devices and configuration software, regardless of minor version differences. They expect clearer instructions on hardware-software compatibility and requirements.
